newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen supported by firm dollar.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen supported by firm dollar.

text.p: A firm dollar was expected to provide support for French shares at Tuesday's opening, traders said, although some operators were taking a cautious view following nervousness on Wall Street and weakness on other European bourses.
"The dollar's going through the roof," one broker said, while another said it "looks like another roaring day".
The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed up 13.18 points or 0.45 percent at 2,947.66. The CAC-40 futures contract on GLOBEX was down three at 2,952 from Monday's close.

* Alcatel Alsthom may be featured. General Electric Co Plc said it was in talks with Alcatel on the future of their GEC Alsthom power engineering joint venture, as part of its strategic move away from joint ventures towards defence and aerospace activities.
* PSA Peugeot Citroen may get a boost from a research note from broker Oddo which sees PSA offering good value compared to other European carmakers.
* Remy Cointreau. One broker said he is expecting the drinks company to report 1996/97 profit between 120-135 million francs after exceptionals.
